header.title: Better Communication Across Cultures at Work
header.subtitle: Helping international teams and local staff communicate and collaborate effectively across cultures
header.description: Practical, discussion-based workshops that enhance communication and collaboration in multicultural workplaces and international business. I help individuals and teams build cultural awareness, navigate different communication styles and approaches to decision-making, and work together more effectively across cultures.

image.alt: Genevieve, intercultural communication trainer, smiling outdoors among spring blossoms

about.title: About
about.body:
I am an intercultural trainer specialising in communication and collaboration in multicultural workplaces. I work in higher education and with companies. Through my teaching and training, I have gained valuable experience working with people from a wide range of cultural backgrounds. My own experience of living and working in different countries further enriches this perspective.

My workshops are tailored to the needs of each organisation. Using real-life examples, workplace situations and interactive activities, participants develop practical communication and collaboration skills that they can immediately apply in their own workplace.

All workshops are delivered in English. Drawing on my background as a Business English trainer, I adapt my language and communication style to suit participants' English proficiency levels, ensuring an inclusive and engaging learning environment.

My academic background includes a Master's degree in Adult Learning in Global Change, a Postgraduate Diploma in Intercultural Competence, and a Bachelor's degree in Psychology and Sociology.

items.quote:
During my time as Head of the Higher Education Teaching and Learning Programme at Salzburg University of Applied Sciences, I greatly valued my collaboration with Genevieve Navisotschnig. She is full of ideas, and together we developed successful workshops.

I appreciate Genevieve's professionalism and her profound knowledge of the subject. She not only approaches intercultural communication from a theoretical perspective but also draws on her own life experience, which gives her genuine authenticity in this field.

As a result, she is able to inspire participants to engage with these topics. At the same time, she always adopts a practical approach that stimulates interest in the underlying theory.

For me, every opportunity to work with Genevieve Navisotschnig has been personally enriching.
items.name: Ulrike Szigeti, Former Vice Rector and International Coordinator, FH Salzburg

items.quote:
I've been working with Genevieve as my Business English trainer for the past four years. Through our sessions, she has helped me develop the communication skills and confidence I need when working with colleagues and clients from different countries. When I think back to where I started compared with where I am today, my communication skills and confidence have improved enormously, and Genevieve has played a significant role in that progress.

Our sessions are always engaging because we discuss a wide variety of business and current topics. Genevieve is highly adaptable and always ensures our discussions are relevant to my work and interests. I also appreciate receiving lesson materials in advance, which gives me time to prepare and complete exercises.

I particularly appreciate her wide-ranging knowledge, her open communication, and her friendly personality.

I would highly recommend Genevieve to anyone looking for a knowledgeable, adaptable and professional trainer.
items.name: Gerhard Santner, Sales Manager, Packaging Industry, Austria
